probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method of providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising the steps of: (a) providing a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites; (b) receiving a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (c) sending a request based on said search query to a computerised system of a contact center __in response to a user action selecting a contact center option__; (d) receiving, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, wherein said contact center link, when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __that is selected based on analysis of said search query and said request by said contact center system__; and (e) returning said contact center link to said user as part of a response to said search query __wherein said contact center link is distinct from document links returned in response to said search query__.

2. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, further comprising the steps of conducting a search within said documents on one or more websites in response to said search query __to identify documents matching said search query__, and returning at least one document link to one of said documents as part of said response to said search query __wherein said document links are presented separately from said contact center link__.

3. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 2, further comprising the step of formatting said response to said search query to display a first result set including said document link and a second result set including said contact center link __wherein said first and second result sets are visually distinguished from one another__.

4. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) enable a plurality of contact center links to be provided to said user __each corresponding to a different resource or queue of the contact center selected based on said search query__.

5. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) comprise said contact center link __generated by said contact center system based on said request__.

6. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) comprise an identifier of a link __that is generated by said contact center system and__ cached by the search engine.

7. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link is generated uniquely for said user __by said contact center system__, whereby activation of the link initiates an interactive communications session recognisable by the contact center as relating to said request from said search engine __and enables said contact center to track the origin of said communications session__.

8. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said request sent to said contact center includes an identifier of said user __provided by said search engine__, whereby a subsequent interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center arising from initiation of said contact center link enables the contact center to associate said interactive communications session with said request from the search engine __and to maintain a record of said association__.

9. (Original) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 8, wherein said identifier of said user is a network address of said user.

10. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a predetermined agent of the contact center __that is__ selected in response to said request __based on agent availability and skillset matching__.

11. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a predetermined queue of agents of the contact center selected in response to said request __based on queue assignment rules stored in said contact center system__.

12. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said link is configured to initiate a communications session from a compatible communications application, if such application is available on said user's computer __and wherein said contact center system determines compatibility based on said user's system configuration__.

13. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is a voice or video telephony application __that is detected on said user's computer__.

14. (Original) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is an instant messaging (IM) application.

15. (Original) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is integrated with a browser employed by the user to access the search engine interface.

16. (New) [Claim 16 is cancelled due to misnumbering.]

17. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link contains parameters representing customer requirements __derived from said search query__ which are passed to said contact center within an interactive communications session initiated on activation of said contact center link.

18. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said parameters are indicative of one or more skillset parameters employed by a management system of said contact center, whereby said communications session may be directly assigned to a skillset based on the parameters __without requiring manual agent assignment__.

19. (Cancelled)

20. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented search engine system providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising: (a) a server for providing a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites and receiving a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (b) an interface for providing communication with a computerised system of a contact center __wherein said interface is configured to transmit requests to said contact center system in response to user actions selecting contact center options__; (c) a request generator for formulating a request based on said search query for sending to said computerised system of a contact center __wherein said request includes user identification information and search query parameters__; (d) a results generator for providing to said user a contact center link based on data received in response to said request, said contact center link being configured such that, when activated, it enables an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __wherein said contact center link is generated by said contact center system and is distinct from document search results__.

21. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method of providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising the steps of: (a) receiving from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __wherein said request includes user identification information__; (b) determining, from said request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that correlate search query characteristics with contact center resources__; (c) sending to the search engine, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, whereby said contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and said selected resource of the contact center __wherein said data is generated by said contact center system__; (d) receiving, from said user, a communications session initiation from which said selected resource may be identified __and wherein said communications session initiation includes said contact center link parameters__; and (e) directing said communications session to said selected resource __based on said parameters and said user identification information__.

22. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprise an address of said selected resource __generated by said contact center system__, whereby activation of the link enables the user to initiate a communications session directly with said resource.

23. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprises an identification, for inclusion in a contact center link to be returned to the user, of one or more skillset parameters employed by a management system of said contact center, whereby said communications session may be directly assigned to a skillset based on the parameters __without requiring manual routing__.

24. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprises a unique identifier, for inclusion in a contact center link to be returned to the user, said unique identifier being assigned to said request received from said search engine __by said contact center system__, whereby a later communications session may be associated with said request based on said unique identifier being communicated within said communications session.

25. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, further comprising the step, carried out after having received a communications session initiation from the user, of amending the stored rules __based on the outcome of said communications session__.

26. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 25, wherein the amendment of the stored rules confirms an association between the request received from the search engine and the resource identified in a contact center link activated by the user __and wherein said amendment is used to improve future resource selection__.

27. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 25, wherein the amendment of the stored rules confirms an association between the request received from the search engine and a resource of the contact center which is different from that specified in a contact center link activated by the user but to which the user's communications session is ultimately directed __and wherein said amendment reflects actual resource availability and performance__.

28. (Cancelled)

29. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented contact center system for providing users with access to a resource of a contact center system, comprising (a) an interface for receiving from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __wherein said request includes user identification information and search query parameters__ and for returning data to the search engine in response to the request __wherein said data includes a contact center link generated by said contact center system__; (b) a storage area storing rules for determining, from the request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that correlate search query characteristics and user information with contact center resources and skillsets__; and (c) processing means programmed to determine the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on the stored rules and to generate data enabling a contact center link to be provided to the user, whereby the contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and the selected resource of the contact center __wherein said processing means generates said contact center link with parameters derived from said request and said stored rules__; wherein the processor is operably connected to the interface to receive the request therefrom and to provide the data thereto.
